namespace Blueprint.Model.Attributes;

/// <summary>
/// A "self" link for this operation, linking it from the resource to itself.
/// </summary>
[System.AttributeUsage(System.AttributeTargets.Class, AllowMultiple = false, Inherited = true)]
// MarkerAttribute

{
